title: Copy events and columns between grid views
summary: Copies the events of a grid view, its columns and their events to another view of the same form, or one event, as a change set; dry run by default
intro: Read this when a second grid view of a form should behave like the first. `drag-lint repo copy-grid --dfm <form.dfm> --from <view> --to <view>` prints the events and the columns it would copy; --apply or --select writes them with a backup, and a --select file must hold the plan id of the dry run its ids are from. With --event only that one event is copied. Both views are in ONE form; --list shows the views and their events.

help: drag-lint repo copy-grid      --dfm <file.dfm> [--unit <file.pas>] (--from <view> --to <view> [--event <name> [--from-column <col> [--to-column <col>]]] | --list [--from <view>]) (--repo <file> | --project <project file>) [--apply | --select <id file>] [--dry-run] [--json]   (copies the events of a grid view, its columns and their events to another view of the SAME form, between table / banded table / card / layout views, or with --event ONE event; a new column is declared in the unit; every byte outside a change stays, the new text is checked by the Delphi reader first, each changed file gets a backup; what cannot be settled is BLOCKED, what needs a look is unchecked; --list shows the views and, with --from, their events; the repository is not opened; no --apply = dry run; a --select file needs the # plan line of its dry run; exit 1 view / event / write failure or a changed plan, 2 usage)

questions.ask: How do I give a banded or card view the events and columns of my table view?
How do I copy just one event handler to another grid view?
Which views and events does a form have?
